# Marine Collective WIP Concept v1 — Generation Record

## Status

Unbranded WIP visual-development exploration. Not canon, identity, scientific
evidence, species identification, partner material, or a production web asset.

## Prompt

Create a wide 16:9 visual-development concept board for an INTERNAL, UNBRANDED,
WORK-IN-PROGRESS marine intelligence engineering collective. This is stylized
concept art, not a logo, not canonical brand art, not scientific evidence, not a
real species observation, and not a production website asset.

Scene: a beautiful collective portrait of twelve distinct abstract bio-digital
marine engineering archetypes arranged in four subtle spatial clusters inside a
vast near-black abyssal environment. Each archetype must have a clearly different
silhouette, posture, material, and functional artifact:

1. evidence/source librarian with floating provenance ribbons;
2. uncertainty translator with translucent probability membranes;
3. sensitive-place guardian shielding an intentionally blurred coordinate field;
4. claim verifier with a precise inspection lens;
5. connector architect weaving several source threads into one clean schema;
6. failure-state engineer holding fractured-but-contained data shards;
7. interoperability engineer with modular protocol rings;
8. transformation steward with a visible stepwise lineage;
9. bounded Guardian conductor coordinating a small auditable task graph;
10. human handoff designer illuminating a warm approval token;
11. evidence visualizer shaping bathymetric contours into a readable composition;
12. accessibility/performance release engineer balancing contrast, motion
    restraint, and lightweight assets.

Art direction: premium editorial science-fiction concept art, quiet technical
wonder, abyssal depth, charcoal and deep navy fields, controlled cyan and teal
hydrographic glow, very restrained warm amber only for human attention and
approval, fine bathymetric contour lines, particulate depth, translucent evidence
membranes, luminous provenance threads, tactile materials, strong negative space,
cinematic but calm. Characters can be humanoid/abstract hybrid silhouettes with
subtle marine-inspired forms, but do not depict recognizable real wildlife as
observed animals. Make every figure elegant, capable, and non-militarized.

Composition: readable as one collective, with the central negative space
suggesting shared intelligence and responsibility rather than a command throne.
No central messiah figure. No text, letters, captions, numbers, logos, trademarks,
maps with identifiable locations, precise coordinates, UI dashboards, partner
marks, sonar screens, fake metrics, fake telemetry, live-feed indicators, generic
AI brain imagery, surveillance aesthetics, mystical prophecy, weapons, photoreal
dolphins, or stock coral-reef tourism imagery. High detail, coherent lighting,
sophisticated silhouettes, exhibition-quality concept painting.

## Visual QA

The output succeeds as a cinematic collective mood board and makes provenance,
uncertainty, sensitivity, protocol, review, and human-approval artifacts legible.
It reads as roughly eleven primary figures rather than a reliable twelve-role
roster. Do not use it for character counting or canonical identity; later approved
character sheets should isolate one role per reference sheet.
